title: Bathou Religion, Spiritual Philosophy & Cosmic Worldview
supreme_deity: Bathou Bwrai / Sibrai (The Eternal Formless Supreme Creator)

five_elements.role: Foundation of physical existence, agriculture and mortal body.
Purifier of ritual, life-giving river, source of renewal.
Cosmic spark, transformation, sacrificial agent in rituals.
Breath of life (prana), motion, carrier of prayers.
Infinite cosmic space embracing all creation.

sacred_symbols.meaning: Living divine emblem of Bathou Bwrai planted in the Sithla (courtyard). Never pruned; its five ridges represent the five cosmic elements.
Woven fence encircling the Sijou plant. The 18 pairs symbolize the 18 moral virtues and cosmic duties governing righteous human society.
Sanctifying agents used during worship to sprinkle pure stream water on congregants.

reform_movements.name: Brahma Dharma Movement
reform_movements.historical_significance: A major socio-spiritual reformation initiated in the early 20th century. Introduced Vedic homa/yajna fire rituals while purifying superstitious practices, eradicating child marriage, and creating schools across Bodoland.
